title: PaletteBuilder plugins
description: Easily create smart color palettes based on the colors you choose to be the edges
body:
🎨 BlockGradient | The Ultimate Builder's Palette Generator
BlockGradient is a powerful, lightweight, and incredibly smart building tool designed for Minecraft creators, builders, and designers.

Have you ever spent hours manually figuring out which blocks to use to create the perfect smooth gradient for your walls, terrain, or mega-builds? With BlockGradient, you can instantly generate flawless, multi-material color transitions between any two points in your world based on real-world RGB color math and human perception algorithms.

✨ Features
🧮 Advanced RGB Lerp Algorithm: Unlike basic tools that use generic Minecraft map colors, BlockGradient utilizes custom, accurate RGB data for each block, ensuring the smoothest transition possible.

🧱 Smart Multi-Material Blending: The plugin automatically mixes and blends different texture types—Concrete, Concrete Powder, Terracotta, Glazed Terracotta, and Wool—to mimic professional, hand-built gradient lines.

📏 Dynamic Distance Scaling: The plugin dynamically calculates the exact distance between your positions and stretches or compresses the color palette perfectly to fit the space.

⚡ Performance Optimized: Built with safety guardrails (maximum distance caps) to ensure zero server lag or crashes, even on big public build servers.

⌨️ Full Tab-Completion Support: User-friendly command execution with smart tab-completes so you never have to remember the syntax.

🛠️ How It Works
Creating a professional color gradient is as simple as 1, 2, 3:

Select Point 1: Look at your starting block (e.g., Red Concrete) and type /cp pos1.

Select Point 2: Look at your ending block (e.g., White Concrete) and type /cp pos2.

Generate: Type /cp create.

The plugin will analyze the exact distance between the two blocks, calculate the mathematical color percentages needed per block, and instantly construct a breathtaking, smooth gradient line directly in your world!

💻 Commands & Permissions
Command	Description	Permission
/cp pos1	Sets the first color and position of the gradient.	blockgradient.use
/cp pos2	Sets the second color and position of the gradient.	blockgradient.use
/cp create	Dynamically generates the color palette between the points.	blockgradient.use
📝 Configuration & Technical Details
Supported Platforms: Spigot, Paper, Purpur, and all modern forks.

API Version: Optimized for Minecraft 1.20 and newer (up to 1.21.x).

No Dependencies Required: Completely standalone! Just drop the .jar file into your plugins folder and restart your server.



No responsibility is taken for any malfunction that may occur.
